text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm in the middle of tidying my office when Fuji Kiseki suddenly comes in.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you, Trainer, but do you happen to have any extra tissue boxes?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I forgot to order a new batch for the dorm, and I don't have the energy to go buy more…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to bring some back once our regular order comes in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes her request, then makes to leave the office empty-handed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ack! What am I doing?! I haven't even gotten the tissues yet!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sigh… How could I be so scatterbrained?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must be overtaxed from running so many races in a row. I should revise her racing schedule a little…
